# THE CRUCIBLE

> A growth community for young people who want to build themselves and make real impact. Self-building, leadership and impact. This is not church. This is a training ground.

F.O.R.G.E: Faithful Ones Raised, Grounded & Equipped. Anchor verse: 1 Timothy 4:12, "Don't let anyone look down on you because you are young, but set an example in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith and in purity."

## What we believe

Young people were not made to just scroll, follow trends, and wait for "later." You can grow now. You can lead now. You can make a difference now. So THE CRUCIBLE is a space where pressure becomes progress. Like gold in fire, members get tested, trained and sharpened until they come out better.

## Three pillars

- Self-building: master your mind, build discipline, manage your time and grow confidence.
- Leadership: lead yourself, influence your friends, communicate with clarity and stand for what's right, in school, online and everywhere.
- Impact: turn your gifts into value for your families, schools and communities.

## Programmes

- CRUCIBLE · The Minded (weekly): Weekly sessions on self-building: practical habits, mindset tools, discipline, time management and confidence, and how to stay focused in a world full of distractions.
- CRUCIBLE · The Forge (monthly): Monthly sessions on leadership: leading yourself, influencing friends, communicating with clarity and standing for what's right, plus how to handle pressure, failure and tough seasons and turn tests into testimonies.
- CRUCIBLE · Vessels of Honor: Real-life skills for impact: communication, creativity, money, problem-solving and personal brand, turning your gifts into value for your family, school and community.

## Who it's for

Young people who are hungry to grow: tired of just existing and ready to build themselves, sharpen their skills and leave a mark.

## Join

Use the join form at https://crucible.etienodouglas.online/#join.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is THE CRUCIBLE?

THE CRUCIBLE is a growth community for young people who want to build themselves and make real impact. It focuses on three things: self-building, leadership and impact. Like gold in fire, members get tested, trained and sharpened until they come out better.

### Is THE CRUCIBLE a church?

No. This is not church. This is a training ground. It is rooted in faith: F.O.R.G.E stands for Faithful Ones Raised, Grounded & Equipped, and its anchor verse is 1 Timothy 4:12.

### What does F.O.R.G.E stand for?

F.O.R.G.E stands for Faithful Ones Raised, Grounded & Equipped.

### Who is THE CRUCIBLE for?

Young people who are hungry to grow. If you are tired of just existing and ready to build yourself, sharpen your skills and leave a mark, you are in the right place.

### What programmes does THE CRUCIBLE run?

Three: CRUCIBLE · The Minded, a weekly session on habits, mindset and focus; CRUCIBLE · The Forge, a monthly session on leadership, pressure, failure and bouncing back; and CRUCIBLE · Vessels of Honor, which builds real-life skills such as communication, creativity, money, problem-solving and personal brand.

### How do I join THE CRUCIBLE?

Fill in the join form on this website with your name, contact details and why you want to join, and you will be invited to the next session.

### Who founded THE CRUCIBLE?

THE CRUCIBLE was founded by Etieno Douglas, a marketing and creative leader based in Nigeria. His portfolio is at etienodouglas.online.

## Founder

[Etieno Douglas](https://etienodouglas.online/): marketing and creative leader based in Nigeria.
